title: CLOSE: A Calibrated Label-free Online Self-Evaluating Verifier for Object Hallucination in Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.28589v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language models frequently describe objects absent from the image because of language priors. Yet the model itself is already a strong judge of its own output: asked separately whether an object is present, it rejects 44%-62% of its hallucinations, and its yes probability reaches an AUROC of 0.90-0.95 without training. This judgment, however, is not directly usable: (1) its probabilities lack a common scale across models; (2) for the remaining 38%-56%, the model still answers yes with probabilities that overlap those of real objects, so no threshold separates them. We therefore propose CLOSE, a Calibrated Label-free Online Self-Evaluating verifier that enforces this judgment during generation. Its threshold is a quantile of a memory rather than a probability and thus depends only on ranks; the memory is cold-started from unlabeled images and updated online. translated_title: CLOSE：一种面向视觉-语言模型物体幻觉的校准、无标注、在线自评估验证器
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言模型经常因为语言先验而描述图像中并不存在的物体。然而，模型本身已经是其自身输出的强大判断者：当被单独询问某物体是否存在时，它会拒绝44%-62%的自身幻觉，且其“是”的概率在无需训练的情况下即可达到0.90-0.95的AUROC。然而这一判断并不能直接使用：(1) 其概率在不同模型之间缺乏统一的尺度；(2) 对于剩余38%-56%的幻觉，模型仍会以与真实物体概率相重叠的“是”概率作答，因此没有任何阈值能够将它们区分开。为此，我们提出CLOSE，一种校准的、无标注的、在线自评估的验证器，可在生成过程中强制执行这一判断。其阈值是记忆库的分位数而非概率，因此仅依赖于排名；该记忆库通过无标注图像冷启动并在线更新。一个基于四种隐藏状态信号的伪标签自训练的评分器（摘要至此截断）
tldr: 提出CLOSE验证器，利用视觉-语言模型对自身幻觉的内在判断能力，通过基于排名的记忆分位数阈值实现校准、无标注、在线自评估的物体幻觉检测。
en_tdlr: Proposes CLOSE, a calibrated, label-free, online self-evaluating verifier that leverages a vision-language model's inherent ability to judge its own hallucinations, using rank-based quantile thresholds from an online-updated memory to detect object hallucination during generation.
